create_jax_dataarray: create an xarray DataArray backed by JAX arrays using xarray_jax.DataArray with dims and coords
create_jax_dataset: create an xarray Dataset backed by JAX arrays using xarray_jax.Dataset with data_vars and jax_coords
jit_xarray_function: jit compile a function that accepts and returns xarray DataArray or Dataset using jax.jit
scan_xarray_along_dim: scan a function over an xarray Dataset along a named dimension using xarray_jax.scan
pmap_xarray_function: parallel map a function across devices on an xarray Dataset using xarray_jax.pmap
